lines: This influencer promotes real products. But there's one problem... she doesn't exist.
She's an AI influencer. Perfect appearance. Unlimited content. No days off. And no scandals.
For brands, she sounds perfect. She's never late, never tired, and she can create hundreds of videos.
But there's one thing AI still struggles to generate convincingly... Trust.
The winner won't be human, or AI. It will be whoever the audience believes.
Would you buy something recommended by a person who never existed?
